Tester signs in through XSUAA
Steps:
Open the AppRouter URL.
Complete SAP sign-in.
Open the profile menu.
Active Tester SAP identity is mapped to one active IDTS Tester.

Unmapped SAP identity is denied safely
Steps:
Open the AppRouter URL.
Complete SAP sign-in.
Use a valid SAP identity with no active IDTS mapping.
Access is denied with a safe business message and no Bug data is shown.

Role mismatch is denied safely
Steps:
Open the AppRouter URL.
Complete SAP sign-in.
Platform role and mapped IDTS role intentionally differ.
HTTP 403 is handled safely; role internals and protected data are not exposed.

Expired session redirects to sign-in
Steps:
Reload a protected application route.
Complete sign-in again.
The user is redirected to SAP sign-in and can resume without a blank page or raw error.

Logout ends the current session
Steps:
Choose Logout.
Reopen a protected route.
The old session cannot access protected data and SAP sign-in is required again.

Create a valid Bug without assignee
Steps:
Choose Create Bug.
Enter all required values without an assignee.
Save.
Reload the Bug.
Tester is signed in and active code-list values exist.
One active Bug is created as Pending Assignment; reporter and next processor are server-derived and values survive reload.

Choose Create Bug.
Enter required values and choose the Developer.
Save and reload.
One active Assigned Bug is created with the selected assignee and Developer as next processor.

Required title prevents save

Leave Title empty.
Complete the other required values.
Choose Create.

Required description prevents save

Leave Description empty.
Complete the other required values.
Choose Create.

Complete other required values.

Navigate between sections.
Save and reload.

Confirm discard.
Search for the entered title.

Change only the title.
Save and reload.

Return to the Bug.

Wait for completion.
Reload.

Download the attachment.
Compare its SHA-256 with the original.

Delete the attachment.
Confirm.
Reload and attempt the old download.

Attempt upload.
Reload the Bug.

Expand the newest event.

Reload Notifications.

Wait for the worker.

Observe delivery retry state.
Reload the Bug.

Steps:

Reopen the affected section.
A controlled action has just succeeded.
Committed state and audit remain present and no action is duplicated.
